test_cases.title: Straight key to PTT latency
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: PTT asserted no later than t0 + 5 ms in 100 of 100 trials.

test_cases.title: Transmit power into dummy load
test_cases.setup: Article: CWHT-A-001, firmware v1.0.0+0abc123, enclosure lid off. Configuration: 50 ohm BNC dummy load on the antenna port, bench supply 12.0 V at 2 A limit, NanoVNA as power indicator. Safety: transmit only into the dummy load; key-down bursts of 5 s at most; PA heatsink not touched. Environment: room temperature 18 to 28 C, supply 12.0 V plus or minus 0.1 V.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Indicated power between 4.0 W and 6.3 W at each frequency.

test_cases.title: Console banner at 115200 baud
procedure: Boot the image in the emulator with the serial console captured
Read the banner from the capture at 115200 8N1

test_cases.title: Iambic paddle keying across the speed range
procedure: Drive dit and dah paddle GPIOs with a squeeze pattern at 5, 20 and 50 WPM
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Element lengths match PARIS timing within 1 percent at each speed.

test_cases.title: Battery endurance at the 1:9 duty cycle
test_cases.setup: Article: CWHT-A-001 with charged cells, enclosure closed. Configuration: 50 ohm dummy load, keyer driven by the test harness at a 1:9 transmit-to-receive ratio. Safety: dummy load only; cells monitored for temperature by hand every 30 min. Environment: room temperature 18 to 28 C.
procedure: Start the timed duty cycle with the multimeter logging cell voltage
Record the time at which the radio shuts down on low battery
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Shutdown time is 8 h or more.

test_cases.title: RF exposure power density calculation
test_cases.setup: Article: design data at tag baseline/cdr. Configuration: OET Bulletin 65 far-field formula in tools/rf_exposure.py with antenna gain from the datasheet.
procedure: Run tools/rf_exposure.py with 5 W, the antenna gain and 20 cm
Compare the result with the 1.0 mW per square centimeter limit
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Computed power density at 20 cm is 1.0 mW per square centimeter or less.
